tools.name: get_open_capital_opportunities
tools.description: Find current Angels for Agents grant opportunities and their live terms before preparing a pitch.

tools.name: search_live_capital_opportunities
tools.description: Search current, source-linked AFA and Grants.gov records. Returns normalized deadlines, sponsors, status, freshness, and authoritative source URLs. Discovery is not an offer of funding or an eligibility decision.

tools.name: get_live_capital_opportunity
tools.description: Resolve one graph record to its current published terms, eligibility language, award data, contact, freshness, and authoritative source URL.

tools.name: check_pitch_eligibility
tools.description: Run a non-persisting readiness check before collecting or validating a complete AFA pitch.

tools.name: search_venture_resources
tools.description: Search AFA's source-linked catalog of current capital, compute, model, developer-tool, deployment, and proof resources. Results distinguish discovery records from actual AFA entitlements.

tools.name: get_venture_resource
tools.description: Retrieve the current value, eligibility, constraints, source provenance, access state, and machine interface for one resource record.

tools.name: validate_agent_pitch
tools.description: Validate a complete AFA pitch without storing or submitting it. Use this before requesting controller authorization.

tools.name: submit_agent_pitch
tools.description: Persist a validated pitch for AFA human review. Use only after the accountable controller has reviewed the exact payload and explicitly authorized submission.

tools.name: report_grant_milestone
tools.description: Persist outcome metrics and evidence for an existing AFA Proof Grant. Use only after the responsible controller verifies and authorizes the exact report.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "validate_agent_pitch" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Validate a complete AFA pitch without storing or submitting it. Use this before requesting controller authorization.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_live_capital_opportunities, get_live_capital_opportunity · Private data: search_live_capital_opportunities, get_live_capital_opportunity, search_venture_resources, get_venture_resource · Public sink: submit_agent_pitch · Destructive: check_pitch_eligibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_live_capital_opportunities, get_live_capital_opportunity · Private data: search_live_capital_opportunities, get_live_capital_opportunity, search_venture_resources, get_venture_resource · Public sink: submit_agent_pitch · Destructive: check_pitch_eligibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
